<h:html xmlns:h="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:orx="http://openrosa.org/jr/xforms" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2002/xforms" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:jr="http://openrosa.org/javarosa" xmlns:vellum="http://commcarehq.org/xforms/vellum">
	<h:head>
		<h:title>Survey</h:title>
		<model>
			<instance>
				<data xmlns:jrm="http://dev.commcarehq.org/jr/xforms" xmlns="http://openrosa.org/formdesigner/2a43b29b-0917-4196-afa5-88044ab30b5f" uiVersion="1" version="3" name="Survey">
					<report_note />
					<my_village />
					<my_district />
					<my_region />
				</data>
			</instance>
			<instance id="commcaresession" src="jr://instance/session" />
			<instance id="locations" src="jr://fixture/locations" />
			<instance id="places" src="jr://fixture/locations" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/report_note" nodeset="/data/report_note" type="xsd:string" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/my_village" nodeset="/data/my_village" calculate="instance('locations')/locations/location[@id = instance('commcaresession')/session/user/data/commcare_location_id]/name" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/my_district" nodeset="/data/my_district" calculate="instance('locations')/locations/location[@id = instance('locations')/locations/location[@id = instance('commcaresession')/session/user/data/commcare_location_id]/@district_id]/name" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/my_region" nodeset="/data/my_region" calculate="instance('locations')/locations/location[@id = instance('commcaresession')/session/user/data/commcare_location_id]/location_data/region_code" />
			<itext>
				<translation lang="en" default="">
					<text id="report_note-label">
						<value>What happened in the village this week?</value>
					</text>
				</translation>
			</itext>
		</model>
	</h:head>
	<h:body>
		<input vellum:ref="#form/report_note" ref="/data/report_note">
			<label ref="jr:itext('report_note-label')" />
		</input>
	</h:body>
</h:html>"}}
